entities.name: Martin Jakš
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Martin Jakš is a Czech cross-country skier who has competed since 2004. His best World Cup finish was third in a 3.3 km event in Italy in 2008. He also has two wins in the 4 × 10 km relay, earning them in 2007 and 2008.
